rationale.conceptual: The method—DFT with GGA functional, band structure extraction, and Boltzmann transport—is an established multi-part algorithm. It demands careful implementation (input generation, convergence, k-path selection) but no novel theoretical derivation or custom algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline encompasses at least four stages: SCF input generation, SCF calculations, NSCF band-structure runs, and post-processing with BoltzTraP2. Orchestrating these across three compounds and handling dependencies (Quantum ESPRESSO, pseudopotentials) adds moderate engineering complexity.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires reproducing standard DFT band structure and thermopower calculations for three known crystal structures using established open-source tools. The method is non-trivial but well-documented; the pipeline involves several sequential computational stages. Resources are minimal: CPU-only, small memory, no large datasets.

compute_estimate.reasoning: DFT on small unit cells (orthorhombic, 2 formula units) using CPU-only plane-wave code; memory footprint is low (<4 GB RAM), and input data is limited to crystal structure coordinates.
